summary: E2E testing of iteration 6 changes: (a) PPTX + store-info endpoints removed, (b) new Excel Carrefour 5-tab export, (c) RTR Excel renamed, (d) Phasage full sheet 10-column split with white Nuit cell, (e) coloured Date + Secteur/Rayon columns. Backend: 8/8 tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_export_carrefour.py. Frontend (Playwright, logged in as admin): header buttons OK — 'Excel RTR' green rgb(5,104,57) + 'Excel Carrefour' red rgb(185,28,28), no PPT button, no Infos magasin button, no auto-opening dialog after dataset load. Both downloads triggered from the UI: vusion_Carrefour.xlsx (5 tabs, ~13 KB) and vusion_RTR.xlsx (full Excel, several MB). Activity log records 'carrefour_export_downloaded' on every Carrefour download. Récap complet sheet has the 10 expected columns with white Nuit cell. Phasage full sheet in RTR also has 10 columns with white Nuit cell.

design_issues.screen: Header (immediately after page load with restored session)
issues: The 'Session restaurée : vusion.xlsx' toast in the top-right overlaps the Excel Carrefour button for the first 3-4 seconds. A real user can simply wait or click Excel RTR first, but the toast container has a high z-index that intercepts clicks until it fades out. Consider giving toasts a click-through pointer-events:none or anchoring them below the header. Minor UX issue, not blocking.

action_items: Optional: lower z-index or add pointer-events:none on the 'Session restaurée' toast so it doesn't overlap header buttons during the first seconds after a dataset restore.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: /api/export-carrefour/{id} cleanly separates aggregation (_aggregate_phasage_for_export) from rendering (_build_carrefour_export), making future changes easier. Both helpers are colocated around server.py:3612-3760.
GOOD: PPTX export endpoint and store-info PATCH endpoint were fully removed from server.py (now returning 404 as required by the spec). No leftover references in routing.
GOOD: Header.jsx has clean data-testid coverage for export-rtr-button, export-carrefour-button, reset-button, logout-button, sessions-menu-button.
GOOD: The Carrefour file is correctly minimalistic (~13 KB) compared to the RTR file (~1.5 MB) since it contains only the 5 client-facing tabs without raw data.
NIT: server.py is 4064 lines — past the 700-line guideline. A future refactor splitting export logic (RTR + Carrefour) into a dedicated module would help maintainability.
NIT: legacy activity entries for 'pptx_exported' and 'store_info_updated' still exist in MongoDB from previous iterations; not a bug, just historical data.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (header buttons, both downloads, no auto-dialog, activity logging — all verified)
